# Prakrithi Nature Cure Hospital

> A Non-Profitable Charitable Society (Reg. No. ER/779/08) dedicated to drugless Naturopathy treatment, Clinical Yoga, and holistic health in Perumbavoor, Kerala, India.

## Summary & Profile
Prakrithi Nature Cure Hospital provides drugless, natural healthcare treatments that harness the body's self-healing mechanisms. Located on Sophiya College Road in Perumbavoor, Ernakulam District, Kerala, the hospital combines traditional Naturopathy, clinical Yoga, Hydrotherapy, Mud Therapy, Helio-Therapy (Sun Bath), Physiotherapy, and natural dietary regimens.

## Primary Treatment Programs & Methods
- **Yoga & Meditation**: Therapeutic yoga postures, Pranayama (breathing exercises), and structured meditation for mental and physical rejuvenation.
- **Weight Reduction Program**: Comprehensive drugless slimming program integrating custom natural diet, mud baths, sun baths, wet packs, and targeted yoga routines.
- **Hydrotherapy**: Regulated water treatments including spinal bath and hip bath to stimulate circulation and internal organ tone.
- **Mud Therapy & Wet Packs**: Natural mineral-rich mud baths, eye packs, throat packs, and cool wet compresses to absorb subcutaneous toxins and reduce heat.
- **Sun Bath (Helio-Therapy)**: Controlled morning solar energy exposure to stimulate Vitamin D synthesis and tissue purification.
- **Physiotherapy**: Therapeutic movement exercises, physical alignment, and joint rehabilitation routines.
- **Steam Bath Therapy**: Medicated moisture steam baths to open skin pores, induce sweating, and relieve muscle stiffness.
- **Eye Wash, Nose Wash & Enema**: Yogic cleansing procedures (Eye wash, Jala Neti, Enema) for internal digestive and ocular purity.
- **Diet & Fasting Therapy**: Pure organic diets, raw food therapy, fresh fruit juice protocols, and elimination fasting.

## Conditions & Ailments Managed
Diabetes, Obesity, Hypertension (High Blood Pressure), Cholesterol, Heart Diseases (Preventive Care), Arthritis, Back Ache, Constipation, Piles, Migraine, Asthma, Allergies, Psoriasis, Menstrual Disorders, Infertility, Kidney Problems (Supportive), Thyroid Problems, Eye Strain, Stress/Psychological Problems, Supportive Cancer Care.
